name: smart-ats-pro
description: Smart ATS Pro — AI-integrated Recruitment Management System (Monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "SERVER,CLIENT" --prefix-colors "green.bold,cyan.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:share: npm run build --prefix client && concurrently --names "SERVER,TUNNEL" --prefix-colors "green.bold,magenta.bold" --kill-others-on-fail "npm start --prefix server" "npx localtunnel --port 5000"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
